summary:
MARS DEEP is an interactive 3D educational space mission simulation that takes players on a journey from Earth to Mars. Players experience the challenges of planning a robotic space mission, designing a spacecraft, managing engineering resources, completing mission calculations, launching a rocket, navigating through space, entering Mars orbit, and exploring the Martian surface using a rover.

The game combines simplified aerospace engineering concepts with interactive gameplay to make space exploration accessible to people of different ages and educational backgrounds. Players conduct simulated scientific experiments, investigate geological formations, study subsurface structures, monitor environmental conditions, collect samples, capture images, and transmit mission data back to Earth.

Inspired by NASA's Mars exploration missions and scientific instruments, MARS DEEP aims to transform complex space science concepts into an engaging learning experience.

DESIGN. LAUNCH. EXPLORE.
details:
MARS DEEP — Project Details

Project Overview

MARS DEEP is a 3D educational space mission design and Mars exploration simulation developed to make the process of planning and executing a robotic Mars mission interactive and accessible.

Instead of simply reading about space exploration, players become mission planners and participate in the different stages of a Mars expedition, from spacecraft configuration and rocket launch to planetary exploration and scientific data transmission.

How Does It Work?

The game follows a structured five-level campaign containing 23 mandatory engineering tasks.

Players begin by understanding their mission objectives and configuring a spacecraft using different components, power systems, propulsion equipment, communication systems and scientific instruments.

The engineering laboratory introduces simplified calculations involving spacecraft mass, electrical power, propulsion, orbital transfers and mission resources. Players must complete the required tasks to progress through the campaign.

After spacecraft preparation, players experience rocket launch, interplanetary travel, spacecraft manoeuvres and Mars orbital insertion.

Following landing, players deploy and control a rover to explore the Martian surface.

The exploration experience includes four scientific activity categories:

  1. Geological rock analysis.
  2. Subsurface investigation using radar.
  3. Martian environmental monitoring.
  4. Sample collection and scientific analysis.

Players can collect simulated scientific observations, capture rover photographs, and transmit mission information back to Earth.

Benefits and Educational Impact

MARS DEEP aims to make space science easier to understand through interactive learning.

It introduces players to:

  • Spacecraft design and engineering trade-offs.
  • Mass, power and resource management.
  • Rocket propulsion and launch procedures.
  • Interplanetary travel and orbital manoeuvres.
  • Mars landing and rover operations.
  • Planetary geology and scientific instruments.
  • Scientific observation and communication systems.

Beginner-friendly instructions help players who do not have a background in aerospace engineering, while mandatory engineering challenges provide additional learning opportunities.

Technology Used

  • Game Engine: Godot 4.7.2.
  • Programming Language: GDScript.
  • Development Environment: Google Antigravity.
  • Version Control: Git and GitHub.
  • 3D Environment: Native Godot 3D rendering and procedural modelling.
  • Data Storage: JSON-based mission and component configuration.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of MARS DEEP is the combination of mission planning, engineering problem-solving and hands-on planetary exploration in one continuous experience.

Players do not simply watch a Mars mission. They participate in its preparation, launch, navigation, landing, rover deployment and scientific operations.

The project also combines simplified engineering calculations with interactive visual feedback to demonstrate how scientific and engineering decisions influence mission outcomes.

Design Considerations

The project prioritizes accessibility, interactive learning, mission progression and performance.

Complex aerospace terminology is simplified wherever possible, and the game uses guidance indicators, mission objectives and visual feedback to help players understand their responsibilities.

Scientific readings generated within the simulation are educational approximations and are not presented as actual live measurements from Mars.

MARS DEEP is an independent educational project inspired by planetary exploration. It is not an official NASA product or an endorsed NASA mission.
